autostart.description: A configured emulator start at daemon start.

direct_task_run.description: A direct task run from the CLI, the console or MCP.

input_lifecycle.description: A safe reset or an application lifecycle command.

resume_reconnect.description: The reconnect of an instance resume.

daemon_start_preparation.description: The dedicated preparation lease of a connection preparation.

resource_close.description: A dedicated retained-session or pause close lease.

slot.description: A program slot (the wire spelling of InstallSlot).

text_read_budget.description: Which per-consumer text read budget of located OCR text ran out (Workflow #396 REC-1).

calls.description: The provider calls of one consumer.

area.description: The summed region area of one consumer, in pixels.

target_kind.description: Which kind of target a uniqueness check compared (Workflow #396 REC-2).

template.description: A template target: positions of its match score.

ocr.description: A locate OCR target: text blocks and their confidence.

value_side.description: Which side of a value test could not be read (Workflow #396 REC-6).

right.description: The right side, another read value.

value_problem.description: Why one side of a value test could not be read (Workflow #396 REC-6).

invalid.description: The text is not in the declared format.

overflow.description: The number does not fit 64 bits.

out_of_range.description: The value lies outside the declared min..=max.

region_unresolved.description: The OCR target's region could not be resolved on the frame.

low_confidence.description: The read's confidence is missing or below the OCR target's minimum_confidence.

value_op.description: The comparison of a value test (Workflow #396 REC-6).

parses.description: The left side reads in its format.

follow_problem.description: Why a Lab recording's click that follows a template mark does not hold (Workflow #396 REC-4).

not_template.description: The followed mark is not a template mark of the step.

not_required.description: The followed template is only a member of an any_of check, not a required mark of the step's page.

guard_conflict.description: The click guard names another mark than the followed template.

primary_mismatch.description: On the primary frame the template's best match is not at its crop, or not at factor 1000.

template_unmatched.description: On a frame the template does not pass in its search area.

click_outside_frame.description: On a frame the click box that follows the match leaves the frame.

device_category.description: The category of a device failure.

install_source.description: Which resolver rung found the MuMu installation.

count_kind.description: What a MuMu resolution count counts.

configured_adb_class.description: The class of the configured adb.

command.description: A program command or control request. Each Runtime slice adds the commands it reports.

held_check.description: Checking that the new owner is held.

owner_probe_state.description: What the operating system reported about a recorded owner process.

running.description: A process with the recorded id runs.

not_running.description: No process with the recorded id runs.

unknown.description: The operating system did not decide.

transport_kind.description: The kind of HTTP transport failure. Its tokens are registered with the first emitter.

disposition.description: Which side must act on a refusal.

device.description: The device or emulator must change.

uncertain.description: The result is unknown; check the state before trying again.

selection_state.description: The state of the installation selection.

root_tools_state.description: The state of the root Tools.

runtime_state.description: The state of the Runtime process.

not_terminated.description: Asked to stop, but not confirmed terminated.

file_state.description: The state of one file in an integrity check.

device_stage.description: The stage of a device failure. Its tokens are registered with the device codes.

device_backend.description: A capture or input backend. Its tokens are registered with the device codes.

mumu_root_source.description: How the MuMu folder was given or found.

env.description: The folder environment variable names it.

mcp_blocker.description: What must change before an MCP call can work.

server_tier.description: The server's tier must include the tool's tier.

install_root.description: The installation root must be known.

tools_dir.description: The root Tools folder must be known.

material_mode.description: The material mode must allow it.

state_root.description: The Runtime state root must be known (--state-root, or the configuration's state_root).

runtime_upgrade.description: actingd must be a release that serves the request.

input.description: An input field on a page or the command line.

invocation.description: Which entry of a program was invoked.

action.description: An action a run did or plans to do.

control.description: How a Runtime is closed or started.

cold.description: Cold: a shutdown request or a plain start.

language.description: A display language (a BCP 47 language tag).

dir.description: A program folder of an installation.

party_source.description: Where a party's interface ranges come from.

fate.description: What a real run does with an entry under the root.

root_tools_rule.description: Handled by the root Tools rule.

present.description: Which of two paired items is present.

record.description: The record a value is checked against.

section.description: A section of a vision manifest.

side.description: Which side of a decision stopped waiting.

unproved_by.description: Why a release order could not be proved.

installed_record_unreadable.description: The installed record cannot be read.

installed_record_orphaned.description: An installed record exists without an installation.

installed_time_missing.description: The installed release has no publication time.

candidate_time_missing.description: The candidate release has no publication time.

emulator_restart_phase.description: The phase of an emulator restart.

emulator_stop_result.description: How the Stop phase of an emulator restart ended: confirmed, or the token the host's stop-result table gives the stage the Stop failed at.

control.description: The Stop failed without a device diagnostic, at the default control stage (mumu_manager_control).

control_errcode.description: The shutdown command answered an errcode envelope with errcode not 0 (mumu_manager_control_errcode).

wait_timeout.description: The readiness wait for the stopped state expired (mumu_manager_wait_timeout).

run.description: MuMuManager could not be started, or a poll could not run (mumu_manager_run).

timeout.description: The shutdown command passed its bound (mumu_manager_timeout).

path.description: The MuMuManager path is not valid UTF-8 (mumu_manager_path).

errcode.description: An info poll answered an errcode envelope (mumu_manager_errcode).

entry.description: An info poll's instance entry carried an errcode envelope (mumu_manager_entry).

shape.description: An info poll answered an unexpected shape (mumu_manager_shape).

decode.description: An info poll's output is not UTF-8 (mumu_manager_decode).

json.description: An info poll's output is not JSON (mumu_manager_json).

output_bound.description: An info poll's output passed its bound (mumu_manager_output_bound).

unavailable.description: The instance has no MuMuManager binding (emulator_control_binding).

unsupported.description: The provider has no instance control (emulator_control_support).

unregistered.description: The instance is not registered with the provider (emulator_control_registration).

device_process_presence.description: Whether a vendor device process of an emulator instance was still running when a Stop's process listing last looked.

true.description: The last listing still showed the device process.

false.description: The last listing showed no device process of the instance.

unknown.description: No listing answered: it failed, passed its bound or never ran.

ledger_source.description: A revisioned source whose changes the ledger records (Workflow #383).

runtime_facts.description: The scheduler workbench's runtime fact store.

segment_edge.description: The edge of a reported stretch of a condition.

channel.description: The channel a Runtime connection is bound to: one of the general interface's three counters, or the Lab channel (Workflow #389).

cli.description: actingctl, and the installer and scripts that run it.

lab_option.description: One of the two Lab options of the installer page (Workflow #389).

pacing_stage.description: A performance pacing stage of an instance (Workflow #385): s0 is normal pacing, each later stage a worse responsiveness band.

s1.description: First signs: longer intervals and one more retry, never a pause.

s2.description: Tight: longer intervals and more retries, never a pause.

s3.description: Short: dispatch shares fall and the instances with the smallest share pause first.

s4.description: Severe: every dispatch pauses and running policy runs are held.

ladder_class.description: How the recovery ladder's trigger matching reads a code (Workflow #387). Every code entry names exactly one class: the first of these tokens, in this order, whose rule the code meets.

planned_stop.description: 1. Planned stop: a person, a rule or the pack's design stopped the run on purpose (a cancel, a pause, a performance yield or hold, a blackout window, a locked feature).

budget_or_permission.description: 2. Budget or permission: the work lacked time, samples, attempts, quota or permission (a sampling deadline, an insufficient sample budget, a run timeout, an exhausted policy budget).

declaration_error.description: 3. Declaration error: a pack, a binding or a configuration the work uses is itself wrong or incompatible; decided without looking at the screen, the same on every run.

pack_logic_mismatch.description: 4. Pack logic mismatch: the screen or the flow differs from what the pack declares; known only by looking at the screen (an unknown page, a failed or conflicting recognition, an unconfirmed step, an error page, an unmatched entry).

environment_fault.description: 5. Environment fault: a device, a backend, ADB, the emulator or the vision provider could not open or failed, and the work ended because of it.

stability_warning.description: 6. Stability warning: a device, connection, capture or input anomaly on one instance that the Runtime retried or survived; its category is warning or error. Repeated, it shows the environment getting worse.

none.description: 7. Not applicable: a success or an info, a Runtime-internal invariant, a refused request or contract value, a client error or a configuration error.

device_state_probe.description: A device-state read of a handset (model-398 section 7.1).

keyguard.description: dumpsys window policy: the keyguard section.

home.description: cmd package resolve-activity for the home intent.

settings.description: settings get of a screen-timeout setting.

device_config_problem.description: What is wrong with an instance's device declaration (model-398 section 10.1).

kind_unknown.description: device.kind is neither emulator nor handset.

transport_unsupported.description: device.transport is not usb on a handset (tcp is reserved), or is named on an emulator.

endpoint_with_handset.description: A handset names host, port or connect.

serial_in_config.description: A handset names serial: its serial lives only in the private binding file.

discovery_key_with_handset.description: A handset names instance_index, instance_name or nemu_app_index.

backend_kind_unsupported.description: The instance selects a backend its device kind does not allow.

alias_too_long.description: A handset's alias is longer than 248 bytes, so its label would not fit a name.

device_binding_problem.description: What is wrong with the private device-binding file (model-398 section 10.1).

unreadable.description: The file exists but cannot be read as a file.

malformed.description: The file is not JSON of the file's shape and schema, is larger than its bound, or names an alias no instance could have.

duplicate_alias.description: Two bindings name the same alias.

duplicate_serial.description: Two bindings name the same serial: one device is bound to one instance only.

serial_invalid.description: A serial is not 1 to 64 bytes of printable ASCII without white space.

device_link_state.description: The state of a handset's wired device link (model-398 section 4.2). The first six are what the adb server reports for the bound serial; the last two are the Runtime's own.

device.description: adb reports device: the handset answers.

absent.description: The bound serial is not in adb's device list (the cable is out).

unauthorized.description: adb reports unauthorized: a person allows USB debugging on the handset.

no_permissions.description: adb reports no permissions (a driver problem on the host).

other.description: adb reports another state (authorizing, connecting, recovery, sideload, bootloader and the like).

unwatched.description: The link watch is not running, so the Runtime cannot see the link.

unbound.description: The private binding file binds no device to the handset instance.

device_watch_problem.description: What went wrong with the device-link watch (model-398 section 4.3).

spawn_failed.description: The watch process could not be started.

exited.description: The watch process ended, or its output closed.

protocol_invalid.description: The watch's output has a shape the parser does not know.

restart_budget_spent.description: The watch ended more often within the restart window than the restart limit allows.

device_hold.description: What holds a handset (model-398 section 7.3 to 7.5), in the order its availability names the first of them (device_state:<hold>).

locked.description: A keyguard waits for a person (device_locked).

thermal.description: The thermal status reached the hold level (device_thermal_hold).

battery_low.description: On no power source, below the battery level (device_battery_low).

in_use.description: Another application was in the foreground at a run's start (device_in_use).

thermal_status.description: A handset's thermal status (model-398 section 7.1): Android's thermal status levels, mildest first. The device_state thermal keys take these words.

critical.description: Status 4: the platform has done everything it can to reduce power.

emergency.description: Status 5: key components are about to shut down.

shutdown.description: Status 6: the device shuts down at once.

standard_pack_problem.description: What is wrong with a standard-pack root file (Workflow #373 NAV-6).

malformed.description: The file is not JSON of the file's shape and version.

game_mismatch.description: The file's game is not the game directory it sits in.

bundle_invalid.description: bundle.json breaks the bundle index rules.

bundle_missing.description: The game root holds interrupts.json or pages.json but no bundle.json.

pages_missing.description: The game root holds interrupts.json but no pages.json.

page_id_invalid.description: A page id is not 1-64 bytes of [a-z][a-z0-9_]*.

page_duplicate.description: A page id is listed twice.

pages_count.description: pages holds no page, or more than 256.

features_count.description: features names no package, or more than 8.

package_not_listed.description: A named package is not a package of the game root's bundle.

server_duplicate.description: Two packages of one list belong to the same server.

interrupt_page_unlisted.description: An interrupt's page is not a page of pages.json.

interrupt_duplicate.description: Two interrupts name the same page.

packages_count.description: An interrupt's handlers or then.run names no package, or more than 8.

max_per_run_invalid.description: An interrupt's max_per_run is outside 1 to 8.

registry_problem.description: Why a prerequisite package is not bound (Workflow #373 NAV-3a).

game_root_missing.description: The root holds no game root of the dependent package's game.

not_listed.description: The game root's bundle.json does not list the package.

navigation_role.description: The part a standard-pack package plays in a run (Workflow #373).

features.description: The feature package that recognises the pages of pages.json.

edge.description: The package of a navigation.json edge (NAV-5).

chain.description: A step of a navigation.json recovery chain (NAV-5).

handler.description: The handler package of a shared interrupt page.

then_run.description: The package a shared interrupt page's then.run names.

navigation_problem.description: Why a standard-pack package cannot play its part in a run (Workflow #373).

server_missing.description: The list names no package of the run's server.

admission_failed.description: The package could not be admitted; the loader's refusal is the cause.

role_ineligible.description: The package's declarations keep it from the part (execution mode, stability termination, post-admission OCR, resource readings or a designated operation).

identity_mismatch.description: Its game, server or resolution is not the run's package's.

prerequisite_declared.description: It declares a prerequisite package of its own.

entry_mismatch.description: Its entry does not hold the page it is named for.

page_set_mismatch.description: The feature package's pages are not exactly the pages of pages.json.

config_value_problem.description: Why a configuration value is refused, the reason config_value_invalid carries (Workflow #387).

wrong_type.description: The value is not of the key's type.

out_of_range.description: The value is outside the key's allowed range or words.

section_check.description: The value leaves its section failing the section's whole-section check.

repeated_key.description: The request names the key more than once.

duplicate_id.description: Two trigger items of recovery_ladder.triggers share an id (Workflow #387 D1c).

stage_not_allowed.description: A trigger item names no stage, a stage twice, or a stage no item may name (recovery_preparation, resource_fence).

match_missing.description: A trigger item names neither classes nor codes.

code_unknown.description: A code, a code prefix or a ladder class the catalog does not list.

code_retired.description: A code the catalog lists as retired; its replaced_by names the successor.

burst_invalid.description: count and window_ms missing or zero on a stability_warnings item, or present on another.

start_rung_out_of_range.description: A start rung beyond the configured rungs.

rungs_invalid.description: No rung or more than three, an action twice or unknown, or a member of another action.

bound_out_of_range.description: A rung's bound below the device layer's own bound or outside its allowed range.

renewal_cap_exceeded.description: A rung's bound and the hold margin beyond the longest renewal a claim is granted.

claim_ttl_out_of_range.description: A ladder claim's TTL not above the heartbeat bound, beyond the longest renewal, or below the hold margin.

argument_problem.description: What is wrong with one command-line flag or MCP tool argument.

unknown.description: Not a flag of the command or an argument of the tool.

required.description: A required flag or argument is absent.

not_utf8.description: A command-line word that is not UTF-8.

wrong_type.description: Not of the type it must have.

out_of_range.description: A number or a length outside its range (range_min, range_max).

not_recognised.description: Text that is none of the spellings or forms it may take.

conflicting.description: Excludes, or needs, another flag or argument.

unusable.description: Names something that cannot be used: unreadable, not of its kind, or refused.

material_state.description: The state of a Runtime material read (RuntimeMaterialReadState).

verified.description: The material was read and verified.

not_provided.description: The Runtime did not provide the material.

missing.description: The material is missing from the store.

integrity_failed.description: The material failed its integrity check.

source_incomplete.description: The material's source record is incomplete.

material_limit.description: Why a Runtime material read stopped short (RuntimeMaterialReadLimit).

pending_eviction.description: The material is about to be evicted.

budget_exceeded.description: The read would exceed its byte budget.

reply_bytes.description: The reply would exceed its byte bound.

run_state.description: The state of a contained run as its ledger events show it (the runtime client's ContainedRunState).

not_found.description: The ledger has no event of the run.

admitted.description: The run was admitted and has not started.

interrupted_unterminated.description: A Runtime start or takeover came after the run's facts without a terminal; uncertain.

resource_targets_rejection_reason.description: Why the Runtime refused a resource-targets document (the contract's ResourceTargetsRejectionReason).

invalid_json.description: The document is not valid JSON.

duplicate_key.description: An object names a key twice.

unknown_field.description: A field the schema does not have.

invalid_type.description: A field of the wrong type.

invalid_value.description: A field value the schema does not allow.

unsupported_schema_version.description: A schema version the Runtime does not read.

duplicate_id.description: A target id, or a target resource in v2, named twice in the document.

unknown_instance.description: The document names an instance the Runtime's projection does not have.

validity_out_of_range.description: valid_until_unix_ms is not after now, or is more than a year ahead, or has passed.

catalog_unavailable.description: No active resource catalog to check against.

unknown_resource.description: A pool the active catalog does not list.

resource_not_observable.description: A pool that is not observed through a resource or inventory fact.

resource_out_of_scope.description: A pool whose scope does not cover the instance.

unknown_task.description: A task the catalog does not list.

task_out_of_scope.description: A task whose scope does not cover the instance.

task_disabled.description: A task an instance override of the instance disables.

unmapped_task.description: No run of the task produces the target's resource.

duplicate_task.description: A task named more than once in the document.

yield_cause.description: Why performance pacing ended a policy run to be rerun (Workflow #385).

wall_ceiling.description: The run reached its wall-clock ceiling after pacing lengthened it.

preempted.description: The run was preempted while it was held.

connectivity_reason.description: Why the operating system's internet connectivity status is unknown (Workflow #369 S6a): the reason host-metrics' network_connectivity gives.

level_unknown.description: The operating system reported its connectivity level as unknown, or a level this build does not know.

query_failed.description: The connectivity query returned an error code (os_error).

query_unsupported.description: The system library has no connectivity query (a Windows before 10 2004).

library_unavailable.description: The system library of the connectivity query could not be loaded (os_error).

unsupported_os.description: This operating system has no connectivity query.

pacing_cause.description: Why a pacing stage changed (Workflow #385 PERF section 11).

responsiveness.description: The tracked responsiveness moved the stage.

pressure.description: A pressure's stage-one floor began or ended.

idle_recovery.description: Without any evidence, the tracked value recovered toward the top.

pacing_mode.description: How far performance pacing takes effect (Workflow #385 PERF section 10.3): every release ships observe; pace and full are a person's configuration.

observe.description: Measure and record only; nothing takes effect.

pace.description: Lengthen intervals and deadlines, never pause.

full.description: Pacing and proportional pauses, with the learning period.

probe_kind.description: A host probe of the shadow measurement (Workflow #385 PERF section 3.2).

timer.description: Repeated short sleeps; their oversleep is the ready queue's delay.

message.description: A posted message's delay until its thread handles it.

signal_kind.description: A scored signal of the shadow measurement (Workflow #385 PERF section 3.2).

capture_acquire.description: One frame's acquisition from the capture backend.

actingctl_fact_record_invalid.description: actingctl could not read a bounded fact observation file, or it is invalid.

actingctl_output_failed.description: actingctl could not write its JSON output line: serialising the result failed or stdout could not be written. Exit 1.
actingctl_output_failed.common_causes: stdout closed early by the caller (a broken pipe), or a defect in the result's serialisation.
actingctl_output_failed.handling: Keep the reader of actingctl's stdout open until it exits; report it when it repeats.

actingctl_package_resolution_failed.description: actingctl could not resolve the contained task package of task-run.

actingctl_usage_invalid.description: actingctl was given arguments its usage does not allow: an unknown command or option, a missing or repeated value, or a value out of range. argument and argument_problem name the argument and the rule when one argument is at fault, range_min and range_max the allowed range, and variable an invalid ACTINGCOMMAND_DETAIL. Exit 1.
actingctl_usage_invalid.common_causes: A misspelt command or option, or a caller written for another release.
actingctl_usage_invalid.handling: Correct the command line; actingctl without arguments prints its usage.

actingd_fallback_log_failed.description: A start refusal could not be appended to the fallback log %LOCALAPPDATA%\ActingCommand\logs: path names the folder or file, variable is set when LOCALAPPDATA is not. Only a developer line; the refusal itself is still on stderr.
actingd_fallback_log_failed.common_causes: LOCALAPPDATA not set for the starting user, or a logs folder that cannot be created or written.
actingd_fallback_log_failed.handling: Start actingd with stderr redirected to a file, or make the logs folder writable.

action_failed.description: Every action of a recovery graph node failed.

action_id_issue_failed.description: The Runtime host reports action id issue failed.

active_lease_instance_missing.description: The Runtime host reports active lease instance missing.

activity_profile_missing.description: Scheduling decision reason: no activity profile matches the instance.

adb_install_mismatch.description: actingd refused the install root's adb (Workflow #337): a distributed platform-tools binary under <install root>\tools\platform-tools differs from the SHA-256 this build pins. adb_path names the adb, aliases the instances that use it, tools_dir the tools folder and files each finding. A damaged installation, so fatal: check-config refuses at stage config_assemble, a start refuses before the ledger opens and the watchdog holds.
adb_install_mismatch.common_causes: platform-tools replaced by another adb version, or files changed after installation.
adb_install_mismatch.handling: Reinstall tools\platform-tools under the install root with acsetup, or set the instances' adb_path to another adb, then start again.

adb_install_missing.description: actingd refused the install root's adb (Workflow #337): a distributed platform-tools binary under <install root>\tools\platform-tools is missing or cannot be read. adb_path names the adb, aliases the instances that use it, tools_dir the tools folder and files each finding. A damaged installation, so fatal: check-config refuses at stage config_assemble, a start refuses before the ledger opens and the watchdog holds.
adb_install_missing.common_causes: Files removed by antivirus or by hand, or an incomplete installation.
adb_install_missing.handling: Reinstall tools\platform-tools under the install root with acsetup, or set the instances' adb_path to another adb, then start again.

adb_install_pin_invalid.description: The platform-tools pin this build carries (scripts/windows-tools/windows-tool-sources.v1.json, compiled in) cannot be used: it does not decode (the decoder's text is a foreign_data_error link) or does not list the adb among its distributed files. A build defect, so fatal.
adb_install_pin_invalid.common_causes: A release built with a broken or incomplete pin file.
adb_install_pin_invalid.handling: Install a release whose pin is intact; report the build.

adb_path_conflict.description: The failure provider startup records under instance_discovery_conflict when a discovery-bound instance's declared adb_path is not the adb MuMu reports for it: alias names the instance, adb_path the declared adb, other_path the discovered adb and instances what discovery reported.
adb_path_conflict.common_causes: An adb_path pointing at another MuMu installation or another adb.
adb_path_conflict.handling: Remove adb_path (the discovered or the install root's adb is used) or set it to the discovered adb. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

adb_path_encoding_invalid.description: The failure provider startup records when the adb path MuMu reports for a discovery-bound instance is not valid UTF-8: alias names the instance, other_path the discovered adb (converted lossily), adb_path the declared adb when there is one and instances what discovery reported. The start fails as instance_discovery_unavailable.
adb_path_encoding_invalid.common_causes: MuMu installed under a folder whose name is not representable as UTF-8.
adb_path_encoding_invalid.handling: Install MuMu under a folder with a plain name, or bind the instance to the install root's adb by leaving adb_path out.

agent_resume_request_conflict.description: The Runtime host reports agent resume request conflict.

agent_session_expired.description: The Runtime host reports agent session expired.

agent_session_links_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports agent session links invalid.

agent_session_response_missing.description: The Runtime host reports agent session response missing.

agent_session_resume_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports agent session resume invalid.

agent_session_resume_missing.description: The Runtime host reports agent session resume missing.

bind_host_invalid.common_causes: A host name or a typing error in bind_host.

bind_host_not_loopback.description: actingd's configuration member bind_host is an IP address that is not a loopback address; the Runtime listens only on loopback. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
bind_host_not_loopback.common_causes: bind_host set to a LAN or wildcard address to reach the Runtime from another machine.
bind_host_not_loopback.handling: Set bind_host to a loopback address such as 127.0.0.1. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

blackout_active.description: A candidate on the instance is deferred because a blackout (blackout_id: a catalog maintenance event or a host blackout entry) is active; it wakes at the blackout's end (next_eligible_unix_ms). Admission refuses an intent that crossed into the blackout with the same code.
blackout_active.common_causes: A configured maintenance or reset period, or a host blackout such as a planned machine restart.

blackout_approaching.description: A candidate is deferred because its response deadline (required_ms) plus the quiet margin would reach the next blackout's start (blackout_start_unix_ms); it wakes at that blackout's end. Shorter candidates still run, so the instance goes quiet gradually.

blackout_config_invalid.description: A host blackout entry (scheduling.blackout.host) breaks a rule; field points at the member, blackout_id names the entry when it has one. check-config and startup refuse the configuration.
blackout_config_invalid.common_causes: A duplicate id, a weekday outside 1 to 7, a minute of day outside 0 to 1439, or an offset outside the allowed range.
blackout_config_invalid.handling: Fix the entry and commit the configuration again.

blackout_run_stopped.description: A run the Runtime started itself (a ladder rung, a startup package, or a policy run held by performance pacing) was still active when a blackout started and was stopped at its next checkpoint; its cancellation reason is BlackoutStop. A policy run settles as a condition termination and is rerun after the blackout. Client runs (direct and Lab runs) are never stopped this way.
blackout_run_stopped.common_causes: The blackout table changed after the run was admitted, or a ladder rung or startup package outlasted its estimate.
blackout_run_stopped.handling: Nothing to repair for one occurrence.

bundle_maintenance_invalid.description: A bundle's maintenance index does not match its admitted packages or their chains.

bundle_maintenance_pack_missing.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: bundle maintenance pack missing.

c4_client_source_unsupported.description: The Runtime host reports c4 client source unsupported.

call_budget_exhausted.description: An MCP call reached the end of its time budget.

candidate_absent.description: The selected MuMu installation holds none of the candidate files the resolver checks for a needed backend file (the capture DLL, the adb or MuMuManager.exe; count_kind names which, count 0). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
candidate_absent.common_causes: An incomplete or partly removed MuMu installation, or a MuMu release with another folder layout.
candidate_absent.handling: Repair or reinstall MuMu, or configure the file's path explicitly.

candidate_feature_failed.description: No candidate projection: a feature's target could not be evaluated or measured; the recognition error travels as the cause.

candidate_feature_provider_missing.description: No candidate projection: a feature's target needs an OCR or NN provider the evaluator was built without.

candidate_layout_unknown.description: No candidate projection: the recognition pack declares no candidate layout with the requested ID.

candidate_outside_root.description: A backend file candidate (capture DLL, adb or MuMuManager.exe) resolved outside the selected MuMu installation root, for example through a link. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
candidate_outside_root.common_causes: A symbolic link or junction inside the MuMu folder that points elsewhere.
candidate_outside_root.handling: Remove the link and keep the files inside the MuMu installation, or configure the path explicitly.

candidate_production_conflict.description: The ledger reports candidate production conflict.

candidate_projection_budget_exceeded.description: The candidate projection contract refused a value: candidate projection budget exceeded.

candidate_ranked.description: A selection candidate passed every gate and received its rank.

candidate_requires_explicit_disposition.description: The Runtime host reports candidate requires explicit disposition.

candidate_sample_budget_insufficient.description: A running selection step had less time left (remaining_ms) than its candidate sampling needs (required_ms). Settles like recognition_sample_budget_insufficient: a condition termination with a rerun. Not a recovery ladder trigger.
candidate_sample_budget_insufficient.common_causes: Earlier steps used up the task time; host load lengthened the run.
candidate_sample_budget_insufficient.handling: Nothing to repair for one occurrence; the rerun follows.

candidate_sample_deadline_exceeded.description: A candidate sampling of a selection step did not finish within its window, and every observe-only retry (attempts) ran out too. Same rule as recognition_sample_deadline_exceeded: a new timing context per retry, no repeated input, a condition termination with a rerun. Not a recovery ladder trigger.
candidate_sample_deadline_exceeded.common_causes: A slow or stalled emulator under host load.
candidate_sample_deadline_exceeded.handling: Nothing to repair for one occurrence; the rerun follows.

candidate_sample_geometry_changed.description: No candidate projection: a sample frame's geometry differs within the transaction.

candidate_sample_page_or_geometry_change.description: The page or frame geometry changed between candidate samples.

candidate_sample_record_failed.description: No candidate projection: recording a candidate sample evaluation failed.

candidate_samples_unavailable.description: No candidate projection: the frames given do not match the layout's required sample frames.

candidate_sampling_runtime_unsupported.description: The runtime cannot take the candidate samples a select step needs.

candidate_scored.description: A selection candidate received its score from the document's scoring terms.

candidate_search_incomplete.description: The anchor search of a repeated_anchor candidate layout reached its time limit (timeout_ms, 5000) before it had scored every row of the anchor's search region; count is the number of positions that had passed the threshold and the relative color check by then. No partial candidate set is returned, so the projection, and the select step or observation that asked for it, fails. operation, optional, is the caller's location; A2d left the callers' failure detail as text, so none adds it yet.

channel_binding_exists.description: A connection sent BindChannel a second time. The connection keeps the channel it bound first, which channel names.
channel_binding_exists.common_causes: A client defect: the handshake ran twice on one connection.
channel_binding_exists.handling: Report the client defect. A client that needs another channel opens another connection.

channel_binding_missing.description: From #389 U-6 on, a connection that has not bound a channel with BindChannel sent a request other than the handshake (Health, BindChannel). The request is refused before the gate: the refusal is only in the receipt and nothing is written to the ledger. operation names the refused request kind. Until U-6 an unbound connection is bound from the source of its first request's envelope instead (contracts/runtime-interface.md, Channel binding).
channel_binding_missing.common_causes: A client built before #389 U-2, which never sends BindChannel; a client that skipped the handshake.
channel_binding_missing.handling: Use the Tools and the console of the same release as the Runtime: every current frontend binds its channel when it opens a connection.

channel_request_refused.description: From #389 U-6 on, the gate does not take this request kind on this channel: an option-one (authoring) or option-two (debugging) kind on a counter (cli, mcp, ui), a general instruction on the Lab channel, or an external approval on any channel. operation names the request kind and channel the connection's channel. A refused write, and a refused read that would have written a record, is copied by the ledger's request boundary (#383 G14) as command.rejected; a refused pure query is only in the receipt.
channel_request_refused.common_causes: A script sends a Lab operation through actingctl, MCP or the console; actinglab sends a pause, a monitor setting, a fact, a shutdown request or an upgrade-state request; any frontend sends an approval request, while approvals live in the configuration.
channel_request_refused.handling: Send general requests through actingctl, MCP or the console and Lab operations through actinglab; write approvals into the configuration.

check_config_config_missing.description: actingd check-config was given no --config. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
check_config_config_missing.common_causes: A caller that omits the configuration path.

check_config_failed.description: actingd check-config could not run or printed no JSON report.

check_config_option_invalid.description: actingd check-config was given an option other than --config, --config twice, an empty value, or a dangling argument. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
check_config_option_invalid.common_causes: A misspelt option or a missing value.

check_config_passed.description: actingd check-config passed (check-config v2): the configuration loads, assembles and validates as a start would, and the catalog plan was previewed from the ledger read-only. report holds the details; what the check noted (an ignored environment override, the MuMu resolution, an unused device binding, a broken standard-pack root, a missing fact reader) is a note link.
check_config_passed.handling: None; read the note links before committing or starting.

check_config_report_encode_failed.description: actingd check-config could not encode its report as JSON; the report line then carries only this outcome; exit 1.
check_config_report_encode_failed.common_causes: A defect in the report's construction.
check_config_report_encode_failed.handling: Report it with the configuration and the build.

check_config_unavailable.description: ac_binding_draft: actingd check-config gave no report.

check_config_usage_invalid.description: actingd check-config was given more arguments than --config <path>. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
check_config_usage_invalid.common_causes: A caller that passes extra arguments.

client_action_not_recorded.description: Recording the call's client.action in the Runtime failed after actinglab answered.

client_action_replay_payload_mismatch.description: The Runtime host reports client action replay payload mismatch.

client_action_without_req_id.description: actinglab's answer carried no req_id for the call's client.action.

client_channel_refused.description: From #389 U-6 on, the runtime client's own check for a Lab-only session (resource authoring, runtime debug) refused a client whose channel is not lab; channel names the client's channel.
client_channel_refused.common_causes: A program other than actinglab opened a Lab session through the runtime client library.

client_channel_unsupported.description: The Runtime closed the connection on BindChannel without a receipt: an actingd built before #389 U-2. The client reconnected once, checked the owner epoch and goes on without a channel; it sends no BindChannel on later reconnects. Reported once per client process, on stderr or in the MCP warnings.
client_channel_unsupported.common_causes: Root Tools newer than the actingd of the selected slot, for example after a slot rollback.
client_channel_unsupported.handling: Nothing to repair. Each such client process leaves one connection failure in that actingd's ledger; Tools and Runtime of one release bind their channels.

client_fact_replay_ambiguous.description: The Runtime host reports client fact replay ambiguous.

client_fact_replay_origin_conflict.description: The Runtime host reports client fact replay origin conflict.

client_fact_request_id_conflict.description: The Runtime host reports client fact request id conflict.

clock_before_epoch.description: The ledger reports clock before epoch.

clock_slot_deferred.description: A transient gate held back a due clock slot of a policy task on an instance (task_id, alias). An operator scheduling pause is recorded at first sight; a queue wait (a held instance, a retry backoff, an activity interval or any other deferral) or an unavailable instance only at an evaluation where the pair's activity window is closed, that is once the wait outlasted the window. gate_code is the gate's own code. Recorded once per task, instance and occurrence as a goal_missed planning signal whose signal_id is signal:clock_slot:deferred:<sha256 of task, alias and occurrence>; it carries the same values as clock_slot_refused. A later refusal of the same occurrence because its window closed is not recorded.
clock_slot_deferred.common_causes: An operator paused scheduling across the slot; another claim held the instance until the activity window closed; the instance stayed unavailable until the window closed.
clock_slot_deferred.handling: Nothing to repair for an operator pause. For a wait that outlasted the window, check what held the instance (actingctl status) or why it stayed unavailable.

clock_slot_owed.description: A policy dispatch selected for a task on an instance (task_id, alias) serves a clock occurrence (occurrence_unix_ms) from before the activity window it was selected in opened (window_start_unix_ms); for a daily-limited task it uses the new day's budget for an earlier slot. first_run is true when the pair had no earlier dispatch; next_occurrence_unix_ms is the next clock occurrence, so a reader can tell whether the run still served this occurrence. Recorded once, at the first cycle that selects the pair for that occurrence, as a goal_missed planning signal whose signal_id is signal:clock_slot:owed:<sha256 of task, alias and occurrence>.
clock_slot_owed.common_causes: The slot fell while the activity window was closed or the Runtime was not running; a gate held the slot back the day before; a catalog was activated with new task ids outside the window.
clock_slot_owed.handling: Nothing to repair for a single owed run. Owed runs every morning together with refusals of the day's own slot mean that the slot's daily budget is displaced: gate the slot with its own timeline window or move it to the window start.

clock_slot_refused.description: A persistent gate refused a due clock slot of a policy task on an instance (task_id, alias): a budget (policy_budget_exhausted, with budget_dimension), a closed activity window, a task paused by failure suspension, or the configuration (the task disabled for the instance, a missing capability or activity profile). gate_code is the gate's own code. Recorded once per task, instance and occurrence (occurrence_unix_ms) as a goal_missed planning signal whose outcome is this code with these values and whose signal_id is signal:clock_slot:refused:<sha256 of task, alias and occurrence>. window_end_unix_ms is the end of the activity window open at the refusal, next_eligible_unix_ms the first time the pair may be admitted again, next_occurrence_unix_ms the next clock occurrence.
clock_slot_refused.common_causes: A daily or window budget already used that day, often by an owed run that served the previous day's slot; the activity window closed before the slot could run; the task is paused after repeated failures; the task is disabled for the instance, or the instance lacks the operation or a matching activity profile.
clock_slot_refused.handling: Compare next_eligible_unix_ms with next_occurrence_unix_ms: below it, the slot runs later in the same or the next window; at or above it, the slot is lost to the next occurrence. Change the catalog (budget, slot times, activity window) or the instance configuration if the slot must run.

clock_unavailable.description: The system clock is before the Unix epoch or out of range.

color_digest_algorithm_unknown.description: A color digest declaration names an algorithm other than color_digest.v1.

color_digest_cells_invalid.description: A color digest's cells are refused: the hex encoding has the wrong length, is not lowercase hex, or holds a channel above the quantized maximum.

color_digest_exclude_cells_invalid.description: A color digest's exclude_cells list is refused: an index lies outside the grid, the list is not strictly ascending, or it leaves no active cell.

color_digest_grid_invalid.description: A color digest grid is refused: an axis lies outside 1..=32 cells, or the grid has more cells than the region has pixels on an axis.

color_digest_grid_mismatch.description: Two color digests cannot be compared because their grids differ.

color_digest_region_invalid.description: A color digest region is refused: it does not lie inside the frame or its bounds overflow.

command_rejected.description: The diagnostic code of a ledger diagnostic record: command rejected.

command_wait_expired.description: A command's --wait (actingctl emulator start, stop, restart and task-run; actinglab after U-3) ended before its request did: the command stopped waiting after waited_ms and the request (operation, request_id when the command knows it) goes on in the Runtime (Workflow #389 MCP-21).

config_decode_failed.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, #389 MCP-11 ruling Q6, from actingd): the configuration file does not decode as actingd's configuration. actingd refuses to start on it; actingctl packs and ac_packs refuse to read the selected configuration.

config_facts_missing.description: status --config: the runtime fact snapshot holds no config.subsystems or config.parameters record.

config_generation_mismatch.description: actingctl overview or ac_overview found that the configuration generation actingd runs is not the one the installation selects now; path is the selected configuration, which takes effect only when actingd is restarted. The rest of the overview is read as usual.

config_invalid.description: actingd's configuration breaks a top-level rule: schema_version is not the one this build reads, state_root is empty, or secret_fingerprint_salt is outside 16 to 1024 bytes. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_invalid.common_causes: A configuration written for another Runtime release, or a hand edit of these members.
config_invalid.handling: Correct the member or let acsetup write a configuration for the installed Runtime, then run actingd check-config again.

config_key_not_settable.description: A ConfigureSettings change names a key the Runtime reads only at start; it cannot change while the Runtime runs, and the whole request is refused.
config_key_not_settable.common_causes: The key is read before the ledger opens or once by the start-up assembly.
config_key_not_settable.handling: Change the key in the configuration file, commit it with acsetup and restart the daemon.

config_key_unknown.description: A ConfigureSettings change names a key the configuration key table does not have, or a per-instance key of an instance that is not configured; the whole request is refused and nothing changes.
config_key_unknown.common_causes: A misspelt key, a key of a later Runtime, or an instance id that is not in the configuration.
config_key_unknown.handling: Read the keys in effect with actingctl status --config and send the change again with an existing key.

config_manifest_incomplete.description: check-config could not report a value its report must carry from the configuration manifest (a performance pressure streak or a device path entry is missing or of another type). check-config refuses at stage config_assemble.
config_manifest_incomplete.common_causes: A defect: the manifest the assembly built lacks a row the report reads.
config_manifest_incomplete.handling: Report it with the configuration and the build; the configuration itself may be valid.

config_manifest_invalid.description: actingd could not build its configuration manifest: a value the configuration mechanism resolved has another type than the assembly expects, or a member could not be serialised. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_manifest_invalid.common_causes: A defect in the assembly or the configuration mechanism.
config_manifest_invalid.handling: Report it with the configuration and the build.

config_manifest_parameters_too_many.description: Event or record sanitization refused a value: config manifest parameters too many.

config_manifest_subsystems_too_many.description: Event or record sanitization refused a value: config manifest subsystems too many.

config_manifest_value_out_of_range.description: actingd could not put a configured integer or duration into its configuration manifest, because it does not fit the manifest's value range. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_manifest_value_out_of_range.common_causes: A configured value far outside any sensible range that no earlier check refused.
config_manifest_value_out_of_range.handling: Use a value within the documented range. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

config_override_base_changed.description: At start an instruction value was kept although the default it overrode changed in this Runtime release; the file still does not name the key.
config_override_base_changed.common_causes: A new Runtime release changed the key's default.
config_override_base_changed.handling: Check whether the instruction value is still wanted; clear it to take the new default.

config_override_dropped.description: At start an instruction value was dropped because its key no longer exists, can no longer change while the Runtime runs, or its value no longer fits the key.
config_override_dropped.common_causes: The instance was removed from the configuration, or a Runtime release changed the key.
config_override_dropped.handling: Set the key again by instruction if it still applies.

config_override_superseded.description: At start an instruction value was dropped: the configuration file changed or removed the value it overrode, or now names a key whose default it overrode. The later change wins.
config_override_superseded.common_causes: The configuration file was edited and committed after the setting was changed by instruction.
config_override_superseded.handling: Nothing to repair; set the key by instruction again if the file value is not wanted.

config_read_failed.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, #389 MCP-11 ruling Q6, from actingd): reading the configuration file failed. actingd refuses to start on it; actingctl packs and ac_packs refuse to read the selected configuration.

config_settings_changed.description: actingctl config set|clear: the Runtime applied every change.

config_size_invalid.description: actingd's configuration file is not a regular file, is empty, or is larger than the bound actingd reads. check-config refuses at stage config_load; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_size_invalid.common_causes: A truncated or zero-byte file after an interrupted write, a folder given as --config, or a file that is not an actingd configuration.
config_size_invalid.handling: Restore the configuration file (acsetup --commit-config writes it whole) and run actingd check-config again.

config_subsystem_always_on.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem the Runtime always runs; count is the number of allowed client identities when the governance subsystem restricts them.

config_subsystem_configured.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem the configuration file configures: its flag is on or its section is present.

config_subsystem_configured_off.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem the configuration file turns off with its flag; an env_overrides subsystem carries each ignored ACTINGCOMMAND_* variable as a note link of env_override_ignored.

config_subsystem_discovery_bound.description: The configuration manifest reports a discovery subsystem on: count instances are bound by instance_index or instance_name.

config_subsystem_discovery_unbound.description: The configuration manifest reports a discovery subsystem off: no instance is bound by instance_index or instance_name.

config_subsystem_flag_absent.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem whose flag the configuration file does not name, so its default applies; an env_overrides subsystem carries each ignored ACTINGCOMMAND_* variable as a note link of env_override_ignored.

config_subsystem_section_absent.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem off because the configuration file has no section for it.

config_unavailable.description: actingd cannot read the metadata of its configuration file: the path given with --config (or the configuration the install selection names) does not exist or cannot be opened. check-config refuses at stage config_load; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_unavailable.common_causes: A wrong --config path, a configuration file that was moved or deleted, or a folder the process may not read.
config_unavailable.handling: Pass the path of an existing configuration file, or let acsetup write the configuration again.

config_value_invalid.description: A ConfigureSettings change carries a value of the wrong type or outside the key's range, names the same key twice, or leaves its section failing the section's whole-section check (config_value_problem says which); the whole request is refused and nothing changes.
config_value_invalid.common_causes: A value of another JSON type, a number outside range_min..range_max, or a combination the section does not allow.
config_value_invalid.handling: Send the change again with a value of the key's type and range.

configured_adb_identity_unrecognized.description: The configured adb does not identify a MuMu installation root, so it cannot be tied to the installation Nemu capture uses; adb and capture must share one installation identity. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.

configured_adb_identity_unrecognized.handling: Use MuMu's own adb for Nemu capture, or choose another capture backend for the instance.

cost_commit_time_insufficient.handling: Nothing to repair for one occurrence; the rerun follows. Frequent occurrences mean after_ms or the task timeout needs another look (contracts/cost-commit.md).
