frame_switches_unavailable.description: The frame listing found no config.parameters.top_level runtime fact naming the three frame retention switches, so it cannot class frames as actingd does.

frame_workspace_unavailable.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): frame workspace unavailable.

gate_rejected.description: A selection gate (rule_id) does not hold for the candidate, which is rejected.

gate_unknown_aborted.description: A selection gate (rule_id) met an unknown input and its document ends the evaluation.

gate_unknown_dropped.description: A selection gate (rule_id) met an unknown input and its document drops the candidate.

gate_unknown_substituted.description: A selection gate (rule_id) met an unknown input and used its declared verdict.

governance_allowed_clients_invalid.description: actingd refused its configuration: governance.allowed_clients is invalid.

governance_authority_required.description: The Runtime host reports governance authority required.

governance_capability_retired.description: actingd's configuration names the retired governance capability member, which this build no longer accepts. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
governance_capability_retired.common_causes: A configuration written for an earlier Runtime release.
governance_capability_retired.handling: Remove the retired member (acsetup --commit-config writes a current configuration) and run actingd check-config again.

governance_client_not_allowed.description: The Runtime refused a governance identity card: governance client not allowed.

governance_connection_state_conflict.description: The Runtime host reports governance connection state conflict.

governance_identity_already_declared.description: The Runtime refused a governance identity card: governance identity already declared.

governance_instance_unknown.description: The Runtime refused a governance identity card: governance instance unknown.

handle_unknown.description: No job of this MCP server process has the handle.

heavy_scene_budget_deferred.description: Scheduling decision reason: higher-ranked dispatches consumed the host's heavy-scene concurrency budget.

heavy_scene_budget_exhausted.description: Scheduling decision reason: the host has no heavy-scene concurrency budget left.

held_timeout.description: A held start (actingd --install-held) received no release before its deadline; the transition fails with admission closed and the start ends with it. The operation is install_transition.
held_timeout.common_causes: The installer stopped, timed out or lost its connection before it released the new Runtime.
held_timeout.handling: Let the installer finish or roll back; the previous Runtime is started again by the installer or the watchdog.

holder_mismatch.description: The Runtime's wire error code (receipt projection `code`): holder mismatch.

host_budget_deferred.description: Scheduling decision reason: higher-ranked dispatches consumed the shared host budget.

host_capacity_insufficient.description: Scheduling decision reason: the host cannot satisfy the task's load profile.

host_config_overrides_fact_clock_overflo.description: A configuration fact cannot be recorded after the previous one: its observation time would overflow.

host_config_overrides_fact_invalid.description: At start the recorded host.config_overrides fact is not of the shape this build writes; the start fails, and every later start until the ledger is repaired.
host_config_overrides_fact_invalid.common_causes: A ledger written by another build.
host_config_overrides_fact_invalid.handling: Restore a ledger this build wrote, or move the state root aside.

host_config_overrides_persist_failed.description: A ConfigureSettings change could not record host.config_overrides; nothing changed and the request is refused (caused_by: the ledger's refusal).
host_config_overrides_persist_failed.common_causes: The ledger refused the record, for example at its capacity bound.
host_config_overrides_persist_failed.handling: Read the ledger state, then send the change again.

host_config_value_type_invalid.description: A value the configuration in effect holds, or an identity a configuration record needs, is not of the type the reader expects (an internal invariant).

host_conflict.description: The failure provider startup records under instance_discovery_conflict when a discovery-bound instance's declared host differs from the host discovery reports: alias names the instance, adb_host the declared host and instances what discovery reported.
host_conflict.common_causes: A host kept from an explicit entry or from another machine's configuration.
host_conflict.handling: Remove host from the discovery-bound instance or set it to the discovered host. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

host_key_request_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports host key request invalid.

host_package_lease_identity_mismatch.description: The Runtime host reports host package lease identity mismatch.

host_test_observation_install_lock_poiso.description: The Runtime host reports host test observation install lock poisoned.

host_test_observation_owner_overflow.description: The Runtime host reports host test observation owner overflow.

host_test_observation_sink_already_insta.description: The Runtime host reports host test observation sink already installed.

host_test_observation_sink_lock_poisoned.description: The Runtime host reports host test observation sink lock poisoned.

identifier_clock_invalid.description: Identifier issuance failed: identifier clock invalid.

identifier_contract_invalid.description: Identifier issuance failed: identifier contract invalid.

identifier_issuance_failed.description: The scheduler could not issue a lease or request identifier.

identifier_issuer_exhausted.description: Identifier issuance failed: identifier issuer exhausted.

identifier_sequence_exhausted.description: Identifier issuance failed: identifier sequence exhausted.

incomplete_lab_operation_success.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: incomplete lab operation success.

incomplete_resource_close_context.description: Event or record sanitization refused a value: incomplete resource close context.

inconsistent_fact_observation.description: Event or record sanitization refused a value: inconsistent fact observation.

input_action_unsupported.description: An input request names an action this build decodes but does not perform: the single-touch path drag (InputAction::SingleTouchPathDragV1) is reserved until Workflow #406 T-3. The request is refused before any effect; nothing reaches the device.
input_action_unsupported.common_causes: A client built for a later Runtime sent the path drag to this build.
input_action_unsupported.handling: Send the action to a Runtime that performs it, or use a supported input action.

input_backend_close_failed.description: The execution session's input backend failed to close.

input_backend_missing.description: The execution session has no input backend for an input command.

input_backend_open_failed.description: A device self-check failed: input backend open failed.

input_backend_operation_failed.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): input backend operation failed.

input_check_failed.description: A device self-check failed: input check failed.

input_execution_plan_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports input execution plan invalid.

input_failed.description: The diagnostic code of a ledger diagnostic record: input failed.

input_frame_capture_mismatch.description: The frame named for an input commit is not the session's pending captured frame.

input_frame_dimensions_invalid.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: input frame dimensions invalid.

input_frame_not_committed.description: The frame named for an input is not the session's committed input frame.

input_frame_session_missing.description: No execution session holds the frame an input names.

input_frame_unavailable.description: The Runtime host reports input frame unavailable.

input_plan_preparation_failed.description: An input action that passed validation could not be prepared into an executable input plan: a Runtime-internal defect; the work ends before any device input.

install_abort_state_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports install abort state invalid.

install_build_manifest_unreadable.description: actingctl overview or ac_overview could not read the install's build manifest.

install_config_generation_mismatch.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install config generation mismatch.

install_config_path_invalid.description: The --config path a running installed program was given cannot be made absolute.
install_config_path_invalid.common_causes: An empty or malformed path argument.
install_config_path_invalid.handling: Pass the path of the configuration the installation selects.

install_config_selection_mismatch.description: A program running under an install selection was given a --config that is neither the configuration the selection names nor <install root>\actingd.config.json, so it refuses rather than run another configuration than the installed one.
install_config_selection_mismatch.common_causes: A start or a check that names a copy of the configuration or a configuration of another installation.
install_config_selection_mismatch.handling: Pass the selected configuration's path (or <install root>\actingd.config.json); change the configuration with acsetup --commit-config.

install_config_unavailable.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install config unavailable.

install_environment_incomplete.description: Only one of ACTINGCOMMAND_INSTALL_ROOT and ACTINGCOMMAND_INSTALL_SELECTION is set; a program inherits both or neither.
install_environment_incomplete.common_causes: A launcher or a shell that sets one variable, or a variable left over in the environment.
install_environment_incomplete.handling: Set both variables (the installation's launcher does) or neither.

install_environment_root_mismatch.description: The install root inherited through ACTINGCOMMAND_INSTALL_ROOT is not the root the program resolves for itself.
install_environment_root_mismatch.common_causes: A program started with the environment of another installation.
install_environment_root_mismatch.handling: Start the program from the installation the environment names, or clear the inherited variables.

install_environment_root_unavailable.description: The install root inherited through ACTINGCOMMAND_INSTALL_ROOT cannot be resolved.
install_environment_root_unavailable.common_causes: A launcher that passes a root that was moved or does not exist.
install_environment_root_unavailable.handling: Start the program through the installation's launcher, or unset the variables to read the active selection.

install_environment_selection_invalid.description: The selection inherited through ACTINGCOMMAND_INSTALL_SELECTION is not valid Unicode text.
install_environment_selection_invalid.common_causes: A launcher that passes a mangled selection.
install_environment_selection_invalid.handling: Start the program through the installation's launcher, or clear the inherited variables.

install_executable_unavailable.description: The installation check cannot resolve the running program's own executable path.
install_executable_unavailable.common_causes: An OS error, or an executable deleted or renamed while it runs.
install_executable_unavailable.handling: Start the program again from its installation; report the OS error when it repeats.

install_fact_clock_overflow.description: The Runtime host reports install fact clock overflow.

install_fact_field_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports install fact field invalid.

install_held_input_invalid.description: actingd refused its --install-held input: it is longer than 4096 bytes, not UTF-8, or not the held startup's JSON. A start refusal before the ledger opens; exit 1.
install_held_input_invalid.common_causes: An installer of another release that writes a different held-start shape, or an argument cut or mangled by a launcher.
install_held_input_invalid.handling: Start the held Runtime with the installer that matches this release.

install_identity_encode_failed.description: The Runtime host reports install identity encode failed.

install_identity_required.description: The Runtime host reports install identity required.

install_input_hash_mismatch.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install input hash mismatch.

install_input_outside_root.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install input outside root.

install_input_read_failed.description: Reading an installation input (the selection, MEMBERS.json, the selected configuration or provider file) failed after it was opened.
install_input_read_failed.common_causes: The file is locked by another program, or an I/O error on the install volume.
install_input_read_failed.handling: Close the program holding the file and retry; check the volume when it repeats.

install_input_size_invalid.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install input size invalid.

install_input_unavailable.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install input unavailable.

install_members_slot_mismatch.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install members slot mismatch.

install_not_drained.description: The Runtime host reports install not drained.

install_owner_mismatch.description: The Runtime host reports install owner mismatch.

install_owner_stopping.description: The Runtime host reports install owner stopping.

install_pause_scope_mismatch.description: The Runtime host reports install pause scope mismatch.

install_preparation_instance_unavailable.description: An install start (a held start released by the installer) went on although the daemon-start preparation self-check of this instance (instance_id) failed, because at least one other prepared instance passed (INST-1). The instance stays unavailable, as after a failed self-check at a normal start, until a later self-check passes.
install_preparation_instance_unavailable.common_causes: The instance's device did not answer while the new build prepared it.
install_preparation_instance_unavailable.handling: Bring the device back, then run actingctl selfcheck for the instance.

install_preparation_not_authorized.description: The Runtime host reports install preparation not authorized.

install_preparation_selfcheck_failed.description: An install start (a held start released by the installer) whose daemon-start preparation self-checks all failed: at least one instance was prepared and none passed, so the new build reached no device. The start ends under this code during install_transition and the transition fails (INST-1).
install_preparation_selfcheck_failed.common_causes: Every device stopped or unreachable while the new build prepared, or a new build that cannot capture or touch on this machine.
install_preparation_selfcheck_failed.handling: Bring the devices back and run the installation again; when they answer and it still fails, roll back to the previous build.

install_previous_drain_unverified.description: The Runtime host reports install previous drain unverified.

install_previous_owner_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports install previous owner invalid.

install_previous_pause_identity_mismatch.description: The Runtime host reports install previous pause identity mismatch.

install_previous_pause_identity_missing.description: The Runtime host reports install previous pause identity missing.

install_previous_pause_not_settled.description: The Runtime host reports install previous pause not settled.

install_previous_pause_revision_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports install previous pause revision invalid.

install_previous_pause_scope_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports install previous pause scope invalid.

install_previous_pause_time_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports install previous pause time invalid.

install_previous_pauses_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports install previous pauses invalid.

install_previous_pauses_missing.description: The Runtime host reports install previous pauses missing.

install_previous_shutdown_unverified.description: The Runtime host reports install previous shutdown unverified.

install_previous_transition_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports install previous transition invalid.

install_previous_transition_mismatch.description: A held start's previous ticket names another transition than the held start itself; the previous Runtime's drained transition and the new start must share one transition_id.
install_previous_transition_mismatch.common_causes: An installer that mixes the identities of two transitions.
install_previous_transition_mismatch.handling: Start the held Runtime with the ticket of the transition that drained the previous one.

install_previous_transition_missing.description: The Runtime host reports install previous transition missing.

install_previous_verification_timeout.description: The Runtime host reports install previous verification timeout.

install_process_root_mismatch.description: mcp-serve --root names another install root than the process runs from.

install_process_slot_mismatch.description: The program runs from another slot (or another folder) than the one the active selection names, so it refuses to run with that selection's inputs.
install_process_slot_mismatch.common_causes: A program of the unselected slot started after acsetup switched slots, or a shortcut that points into the old slot.
install_process_slot_mismatch.handling: Start the program of the selected slot (the installation's launcher does).

install_process_state_root_mismatch.description: mcp-serve --state-root names another state root than the install's configuration.

install_provider_generation_mismatch.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install provider generation mismatch.

install_provider_retired.description: The install selection actingd runs under still names a vision provider file, which the vision root replaced (Workflow #360). check-config refuses at stage config_load; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
install_provider_retired.common_causes: The installation was committed by an acsetup older than the vision root and has not been reconfigured since.
install_provider_retired.handling: Run the current acsetup to commit the configuration again, which writes a selection without the provider file.

install_release_state_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports install release state invalid.

install_root_unavailable.description: An installation step cannot resolve the install root's canonical path: the slot lock, the active selection or a selection check names a root the OS cannot open.
install_root_unavailable.common_causes: The install root was moved, renamed or deleted while a program runs from it, or the path is not accessible to the process.
install_root_unavailable.handling: Run the program from its installation, or restore the install root; reinstall when it is gone.

install_root_unresolved.description: actingctl does not run from an install root and mcp-serve got no --root.

install_selection_json_invalid.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install selection json invalid.

install_selection_size_invalid.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install selection size invalid.

install_selection_unavailable.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): install selection unavailable.

install_slot_in_use.description: The slot lock is held by another process in a way that excludes this one: the installer holds the slot exclusively while it writes it, or programs run from the slot while the installer wants it.
install_slot_in_use.common_causes: acsetup preparing or replacing that slot, or a Runtime, console or tool still running from it.
install_slot_in_use.handling: Wait for the installer to finish, or stop the programs running from the slot, then retry.

install_slot_lock_failed.description: The OS refused to lock the slot lock file install/slot-<A|B>.lock for a reason other than another holder.
install_slot_lock_failed.common_causes: A file system without lock support, or an OS error.
install_slot_lock_failed.handling: Keep the installation on a local NTFS volume; retry, and report the OS error when it repeats.

install_slot_lock_metadata_failed.description: The slot lock file was opened and locked, but its metadata cannot be read.
install_slot_lock_metadata_failed.common_causes: An OS or file system error on the install volume.
install_slot_lock_metadata_failed.handling: Retry; check the install volume when it repeats.

install_slot_lock_missing.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install slot lock missing.

install_slot_lock_not_empty.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: install slot lock not empty.

install_slot_lock_open_failed.description: The slot lock file install/slot-<A|B>.lock exists but cannot be opened.
install_slot_lock_open_failed.common_causes: Access denied to the install folder, or a program that holds the lock file open exclusively.
install_slot_lock_open_failed.handling: Close the program holding the file, check the install folder's permissions, then retry.

install_slot_unlock_failed.description: Releasing a held slot lock explicitly failed; the handle closes anyway, so the slot is free once the process exits.
install_slot_unlock_failed.handling: None is needed beyond letting the process end; report it when it repeats.

install_startup_shut_down.description: A held start (actingd --install-held) ended because a shutdown request for its owner was accepted before it was released; the operation is install_transition. It is a formal stop: the watchdog holds it and never restarts it.
install_startup_shut_down.common_causes: An installer, the console or actingctl request-shutdown stopped an owner that waited for its release.

install_startup_stopped.description: A held or released start stopped before it finished preparing because the Runtime latched a failure meanwhile. The operation is install_transition; the latched failure is the caused_by link. A restart may succeed, so the watchdog considers a start.
install_startup_stopped.common_causes: A ledger write or another latched failure during the start's preparation.
install_startup_stopped.handling: Read the caused_by link and fix its condition; start again.

install_state_root_unresolved.description: The MCP server cannot tell the Runtime state root.

install_ticket_mismatch.description: The Runtime host reports install ticket mismatch.

install_transition_aborted.description: actingctl install-transition: the Runtime reports the transition in phase aborted: the drain ended and admission reopened on the old owner. transition_id names the transition; the failure code, when the transition has one (drain_timeout), is the caused_by link. Exit 1.
install_transition_aborted.common_causes: A drain that did not finish before its deadline, or an Abort action.
install_transition_aborted.handling: Wait until running work finishes, or give the drain a longer timeout, then begin a new transition.

install_transition_conflict.description: The Runtime host reports install transition conflict.

install_transition_failed.description: actingctl install-transition: the Runtime reports the transition in phase failed, with admission closed. transition_id names the transition; the transition's failure code is the caused_by link. Exit 1.
install_transition_failed.common_causes: A held or released start that timed out (held_timeout, release_timeout), whose preparation failed, or that a latched failure stopped.
install_transition_failed.handling: Read the caused_by link and the Runtime's log; the installer ends the transition and starts the previous Runtime again.

install_transition_receipt_unconfirmed.description: A runtime client call failed: install transition receipt unconfirmed.

install_transition_reported.description: actingctl install-transition: the Runtime answered the transition action. transition_id names the transition and phase the phase the Runtime reports (draining, drained, held, preparing or released); a commit's receipt, the accepted shutdown, reports no phase. Exit 0.
install_transition_reported.common_causes: An install-transition action the Runtime accepted.
install_transition_reported.handling: None; the installer continues with the next action for the reported phase.

install_transition_unknown.description: The Runtime host reports install transition unknown.

installation_absent.description: MuMu resolution found no MuMu installation: no configured folder, no running MuMu process, no usable uninstall registry entry and no vendor folder (count_kind installation_roots, count 0). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
installation_absent.common_causes: MuMu not installed, installed in a folder the resolver does not search, or not running when the resolver relies on its process.
installation_absent.handling: Install MuMu, start it, or set mumu_root (or device_paths.nemu_folder) to its installation folder, then run check-config again.

installation_ambiguous.description: MuMu resolution found more than one MuMu installation root on one resolver rung and cannot choose (count_kind installation_roots, count the number found, install_source the rung). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
installation_ambiguous.common_causes: Several MuMu installations side by side, or leftover folders of an uninstalled release.
installation_ambiguous.handling: Set mumu_root (or device_paths.nemu_folder) to the installation to use, or remove the unused installation.

instance_already_selected.description: Scheduling decision reason: a higher-ranked task already owns the instance in this evaluation round.

instance_ambiguous.description: An instance selector names more than one configured instance.

instance_binding_key_invalid.description: An instance's discovery binding key is invalid: both instance_index and instance_name are set, instance_name is blank, too long or holds a control character, or a discovery-bound instance also names a serial. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
instance_binding_key_invalid.common_causes: Both binding keys written for one instance, or a serial kept from an explicit entry.
instance_binding_key_invalid.handling: Bind the instance by exactly one of instance_index or instance_name, and drop serial. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_binding_malformed.description: Ledger forensics reports instance binding malformed.

instance_bindings_incomplete.description: Ledger forensics reports instance bindings incomplete.

instance_config_invalid.description: An instances[] entry breaks a rule that needs no discovery: an empty adb_path, host or serial, port 0, a startup_package on a fixture instance, or a device instance without an adb_path outside an install root. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
instance_config_invalid.common_causes: An empty or zero value written for an endpoint member, or an instance copied from another kind of entry.
instance_config_invalid.handling: Correct or remove the member named above in that instance. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_discovery_ambiguous.description: Provider startup found more than one discovered emulator instance with the declared instance_name: alias names the configured instance, instance_name the key and instances the candidates. The start fails.
instance_discovery_ambiguous.common_causes: Two MuMu instances with the same name.
instance_discovery_ambiguous.handling: Rename one instance in MuMu, or bind by instance_index instead. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_discovery_conflict.description: Provider startup failed because a declared endpoint value of a discovery-bound instance disagrees with what discovery reported; the recorded failure is adb_path_conflict, host_conflict, port_conflict or port_unverifiable with the declared and discovered values. The start fails.
instance_discovery_conflict.common_causes: A declared adb_path, host or port left over from an explicit entry, or a port declared for a stopped instance.
instance_discovery_conflict.handling: Remove the declared adb_path, host and port of the discovery-bound instance, or make them match discovery. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_discovery_no_match.description: Provider startup found no discovered emulator instance for an instance's binding key: alias names the configured instance and instance_index or instance_name its declared key. The start fails.
instance_discovery_no_match.common_causes: An instance index or name that does not exist in MuMu, or an instance renamed or deleted in MuMu.
instance_discovery_no_match.handling: Correct the instance's instance_index or instance_name to a discovered instance (actingctl emulator discover lists them). Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_discovery_unavailable.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): instance discovery unavailable.

instance_emulator_controlled.description: actingctl emulator start|stop|restart: the Runtime completed the emulator control.

instance_fact_snapshot_too_large_for_fra.description: An InstanceFactSnapshot read (Workflow #389 MCP-4) whose reply receipt would exceed the host's maximum_frame_bytes is refused (receipt state denied) instead of failing the frame write.

instance_facts_reported.description: actingctl facts --instance: one instance's facts (InstanceFactSnapshot) were printed, as ac_facts with scope instance answers them (Workflow #389 MCP-4).

instance_frame_exported.description: actingctl observe --export: the observed frame was read back verified and written to the export folder.

instance_frames_captured.description: actingctl stream: the Runtime captured the frame sequence.

instance_mismatch.description: The Runtime's wire error code (receipt projection `code`): instance mismatch.

instance_not_found.description: A Lab error the contract's Lab error constructors name: instance not found.

instance_not_running.description: The Runtime host reports instance not running.

instance_observed.description: actingctl observe: the Runtime took one read-only frame of the instance.

instance_override_disabled.description: Scheduling decision reason: the task is disabled by its instance override.

instance_port_conflict.description: Ledger forensics reports instance port conflict.

instance_port_unknown.description: Ledger forensics reports instance port unknown.

instance_registration_invalid.description: The execution backend registration of a device instance refused its declaration: the alias, instance id, application identity, touch or capture settings, nemu_app_index pairing or handset binding breaks a registration rule. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
instance_registration_invalid.common_causes: An alias or instance_id that breaks the identifier rules, or a backend combination the registration does not allow.
instance_registration_invalid.handling: Correct the instance's identifiers and backend members. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_reset_done.description: actingctl reset: the Runtime reset the instance.

instance_resources_fence_lifted.description: A preparation of a fenced instance (instance_id) passed its self-check after the unconfirmed close, which proves the close: the resource fence is lifted, the instance's policy availability follows its self-check again and it schedules again (Workflow #403). Recorded once as the outcome of the resource_fence_lifted lifecycle record, which names the passing preparation's instance_preparation_finished record. The proving preparation is the recovery ladder's (after an application or emulator restart) or a person's resume, emulator start or restart, or self-check.
instance_resources_fence_lifted.common_causes: The recovery ladder restarted the application or the emulator and the instance's preparation passed, or a person resumed, restarted or self-checked the instance.

instance_resources_fenced.description: An unconfirmed close of one instance's own resources (instance_id) fenced that instance instead of ending the whole Runtime (Workflow #403). The fenced instance gets no new dispatch and its policy availability is withheld; its key goes only to the recovery ladder, and a person is needed once the ladder ended without proving the close (status resource_fence.awaiting_person). Recorded once when the instance is fenced, as a runtime.failed lifecycle record whose caused_by link is the unconfirmed failure (for example application_backend_operation_failed); the work that met the failure ends with this code, non-fatal, and a policy dispatch to the fenced instance is refused with it. Only a preparation whose self-check passes lifts the fence (instance_resources_fence_lifted). An unconfirmed failure that names no single instance still ends the whole Runtime.
instance_resources_fenced.common_causes: An application, input or capture backend of the instance did not confirm that its processes or handles ended: an adb command that hung while the emulator showed a black screen, a device that stopped answering in the middle of a close.
instance_resources_fenced.handling: Usually nothing: the recovery ladder restarts the application or the emulator and re-prepares the instance. When status shows the fence awaiting a person, bring the device back and run actingctl resume, an emulator restart or actingctl selfcheck for the instance; a passing self-check lifts the fence. If those are refused or keep failing, restart the Runtime: its start prepares and self-checks the instance again, and the other instances are not affected.

The whole Lab channel is closed, general reads included. operation names the refused request kind.
lab_module_not_installed.common_causes: The installation was set up or upgraded without a Lab option; an actinglab.exe copied back by hand.
lab_module_not_installed.handling: Tick a Lab option on the installer's Lab page, or pass acsetup --lab; the Runtime reads the options at its next start.

The Lab channel stays open for the installed option.

lab_module_option_disabled.handling: Tick the other option on the installer's Lab page, or pass acsetup --lab; it takes effect at the next start.

lab_ocr_model_missing.description: Workflow #396 LAB-3, a cause of lab_ocr_unavailable: the vision root's models folder (path) holds model folders, but none is an OCR model.

lab_ocr_runtime_missing.description: Workflow #396 LAB-3, a cause of lab_ocr_unavailable: the vision root has no usable ONNX Runtime library at path (ort\onnxruntime.dll). Its caused_by link is the OS failure when the OS reported one.

lab_ocr_unavailable.description: Workflow #396 LAB-3: an OCR evaluation of actinglab or the Lab cannot run because the offline tool loaded no usable OCR model. The offline tools load the OCR provider the Runtime uses (the in-process ppocr-ctc engine over the model folders of the vision root that the Runtime configuration's vision section names, always on the CPU). A command that would evaluate an OCR target refuses with this code (exit 3) and names the target as target_id; a Lab mark self-test, the first decision of record stop and the capabilities report give it as their reason. path is the vision root when it is known. Its caused_by link says why: lab_ocr_vision_unconfigured, a configuration read or decode code, vision_root_unavailable, vision_models_empty, lab_ocr_model_missing or lab_ocr_runtime_missing.
lab_ocr_unavailable.common_causes: actinglab runs outside an installation, the configuration has no vision section, or the vision root holds no OCR model folder.
lab_ocr_unavailable.handling: Install the OCR model folder and ONNX Runtime under the Runtime's vision root and run actinglab from the installation.

lab_ocr_vision_unconfigured.description: Workflow #396 LAB-3, a cause of lab_ocr_unavailable: the offline tool has no Runtime configuration with a vision section. It does not run from an installation, or the selected configuration has no vision section.

lease_busy.description: An immediate try for an instance met a holder, or an eligible waiting entry that nobody may jump (Workflow #369). A Lab operation's refusal names who is in the way, before any frame or input: holder_kind is the holder's kind on a held instance, or the waiting entry's kind on a free one, where queue_position is that entry's position. A client AcquireLease and the Runtime's dedicated leases are refused with this code too. Registered once in the contract (A2a D3); the host and the scheduler emit it.
lease_busy.common_causes: Another client, a scheduled run, a stuck-recovery ladder or an operator request holds the instance or waits for it.
lease_busy.handling: Nothing ran. Retry once the instance is free; actingctl status shows lease_active and queued_request_count.

lease_cooldown.description: The Runtime's wire error code (receipt projection `code`): lease cooldown.

lease_expired.description: A lease was used, renewed or released after its expiry. Since 0.11.5 it also ends a Runtime-held key (a stuck-recovery ladder, a startup package claim) whose renewal came after the key lapsed: the ladder records its rung failed with this reason and finishes. Since 0.12.0 it ends an operator emulator control's hold the same way: the control records its command.rejected + runtime.failed with this code. Registered once in the contract (A2a D3); the host and the scheduler emit it.
lease_expired.common_causes: A holder that overran its own step bound; a host that was stopping while a ladder held an instance.
lease_expired.handling: Nothing to repair for a Runtime hold: the next trigger starts a new ladder. A client acquires a new lease.

lease_expiry_overflow.description: A lease expiry or queue deadline overflowed the scheduler's monotonic clock.

lease_fencing_denied.description: The diagnostic code of a ledger diagnostic record: lease fencing denied.

lease_mismatch.description: The Runtime's wire error code (receipt projection `code`): lease mismatch.

lease_missing.description: The lease named is no longer the instance's lease. Since 0.11.5 it also ends a Runtime-held key (a stuck-recovery ladder, a startup package claim) whose renewal found the key gone: the ladder records its rung failed with this reason and finishes. Since 0.12.0 it ends an operator emulator control's hold the same way: the control records its command.rejected + runtime.failed with this code. Registered once in the contract (A2a D3); the host and the scheduler emit it.
lease_missing.common_causes: Shutdown cancelled the hold, or the key was handed on after it lapsed.
lease_missing.handling: Nothing to repair for a Runtime hold: the next trigger starts a new ladder. A client acquires a new lease.

lease_not_expired.description: The scheduler refused a lease or queue operation: the lease named for an expiry-only action has not expired.

lease_queue_cancelled.description: The diagnostic code of a ledger diagnostic record: lease queue cancelled.

lease_queue_connection_mismatch.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): lease queue connection mismatch.

lease_queue_disconnected.description: The diagnostic code of a ledger diagnostic record: lease queue disconnected.

lease_queue_expired.description: An operator request waited its cap in its instance's one queue without a grant, and its entry was removed (Workflow #369). The waiting requests are a direct task run (CLI, console, MCP ac_run_pack; cap min(60 s, the run's remaining deadline minus a 30 s run budget)), a safe reset or an application lifecycle command (3 s), a self-check or the reconnect of an instance resume (3 s; a resume is refused before its gate is lifted), and since 0.12.0 an emulator control (CLI, console, MCP ac_emulator; 5 s, once for a restart; nothing is driven). timeout_ms is the cap; holder_kind names the instance's holder when it has one; queue_position is the entry's position when it was removed. Its ledger record is the instance-linked scheduler.denied lease_queue_expired at warning. A client QueueLease whose wait ended is refused with this code too. Registered once in the contract (A2a D3); the host and the scheduler emit it.
lease_queue_expired.common_causes: Another client, a scheduled run, a stuck-recovery ladder or another operator request held the instance for longer than the cap; a takeover cooldown after an unclean restart; business capacity refused the grant for the whole cap.
lease_queue_expired.handling: Nothing ran. Retry once the holder named by holder_kind has released the instance; actingctl status shows lease_active and queued_request_count meanwhile.

ledger_capture_buffer_busy.description: The capture queue's memory segment crossed watermark tier 1 (segment_edge started) or fell back below its release line (ended, with the duration); the flush thread uses larger batches meanwhile (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_capture_buffer_busy.common_causes: A burst of records or a slow disk.

ledger_capture_buffer_overloaded.description: The capture queue crossed watermark tier 3: spilling does not keep up and everything but the batch in flight is spilled; business is not paused (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_capture_buffer_overloaded.common_causes: The disk is too slow for the record rate, or it is failing.
ledger_capture_buffer_overloaded.handling: Look at the disk now; if it fails, the Runtime stops with ledger_write_failed.

ledger_capture_spilled.description: The capture queue crossed watermark tier 2: the oldest records are being spilled to the dump file (started) or spilling stopped (ended, with records and bytes spilled); nothing is dropped (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_capture_spilled.common_causes: The flush thread cannot keep up, usually because the disk is slow or busy.
ledger_capture_spilled.handling: Check the disk that holds the state root if it recurs.

ledger_database_root_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger database root mismatch.

ledger_dump_failed.description: After a failed ledger write the dump could be written neither in the state root nor in the fallback folder (paths: both places tried); the unflushed records are lost and the next start writes a tail gap (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_failed.common_causes: Both the state root's disk and the system disk are full or unwritable.
ledger_dump_failed.handling: Free space or repair the disks, then start the Runtime again.

ledger_dump_imported.description: At start the ledger imported a dump file left by an earlier run: count records appended, duplicate_count skipped because their event id was already in the ledger; dump_sealed tells whether the dump ended with its trailer. The dump file is deleted after this record is committed (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_imported.common_causes: The previous run stopped after a failed ledger write, or crashed while records were spilled to the dump.
ledger_dump_imported.handling: None; look for the cause of the previous stop.

ledger_dump_incomplete.description: A dump file without its trailer ended in a truncated line: its verified part was imported and a gap record covers the rest, from the last verified record to the dump's last modification; the number of lost records is unknown (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_incomplete.common_causes: The process ended while it was spilling records to the dump.
ledger_dump_incomplete.handling: None for the ledger; the gap record marks the time range whose records are missing.

ledger_dump_invalid.description: A line in the middle of a dump file does not match its hash: the verified prefix was imported, a gap record covers the rest and the file was renamed to kept_path, unchanged (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_invalid.common_causes: The dump file was damaged on disk or edited.
ledger_dump_invalid.handling: Keep the renamed file for inspection and check the disk; the Runtime keeps working.

ledger_dump_unsupported.description: The dump file at path declares a dump_version newer than this build reads; the Runtime refuses to start and leaves the file untouched (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_unsupported.common_causes: A newer Runtime wrote the dump and an older one was started on the same state root.
ledger_dump_unsupported.handling: Start the Runtime build that wrote the dump so that it imports it.

ledger_failure.description: The Runtime's wire error code (receipt projection `code`): ledger failure.

ledger_flush_delayed.description: The oldest unflushed record became older than flush_lag_warn_ms (started) or the lag fell back (ended) (Workflow #383 AO-8).
ledger_flush_delayed.common_causes: A slow disk or long reads that delay the writer.
ledger_flush_delayed.handling: None while it ends soon; check the disk if it recurs.

ledger_format_marker_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger format marker mismatch.

ledger_format_unsupported.description: The database holds a format-1 ledger (ledger revision 2, written by v0.11); this Runtime reads only ledger revision 3 (SQLite format 2) and refuses it after reading only its format: before any ledger row is read or written and, at the Runtime's start, before the owner journal and the writer lock.

ledger_index_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger index mismatch.

ledger_initialization_conflict.description: The ledger reports ledger initialization conflict.

ledger_insert_incomplete.description: The ledger reports ledger insert incomplete.

ledger_joint_transaction_unsupported.description: The ledger reports ledger joint transaction unsupported.

ledger_maintenance_completed.description: An actingd ledger-maintenance pass completed: the report holds the receipt, whose status names the operation's result (for verify, which ledger was verified).
ledger_maintenance_completed.common_causes: The maintenance operation did what was asked.

ledger_maintenance_failed.description: actingd ledger-maintenance failed; the maintenance failure names the cause.

ledger_meta_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger meta mismatch.

ledger_meta_missing.description: The ledger reports ledger meta missing.

ledger_migration_conflict.description: The ledger reports ledger migration conflict.

ledger_migration_required.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): ledger migration required.

ledger_not_an_empty_root.description: The ledger reports ledger not an empty root.

ledger_open_measured.description: What a ledger open, or a ledger-maintenance verify read, measured before it failed: the values of ledger_opened, as a note link of the failure.
ledger_open_measured.common_causes: A ledger open or verify that failed partway.
ledger_open_measured.handling: None by itself; handle the failure it is attached to.

ledger_opened.description: The start opened its ledger: the open's measures as values (events read, artifacts and their bytes checked, worker threads, and the SQL read, verify, material and restore times) and its deadline as timeout_ms. actingd writes it as a daemon line before runtime_ready.
ledger_opened.handling: None; long times point at a large ledger or a slow volume.

ledger_prefix_beyond_head.description: The ledger reports ledger prefix beyond head.

ledger_prefix_incomplete.description: The ledger reports ledger prefix incomplete.

ledger_prefix_unsupported.description: The ledger reports ledger prefix unsupported.

ledger_probe_done.description: The ledger's consistency probe ran and found nothing; shown in the status only, never written to the ledger (Workflow #383 AO-8).

ledger_read_budget_exceeded.description: The ledger reports ledger read budget exceeded.

ledger_record_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger record mismatch.

ledger_record_missing.description: The ledger reports ledger record missing.

ledger_record_rejected.description: One captured record failed assembly or sanitizing on the flush thread and was not written; a single-record gap takes its place. For a revisioned source the gap names its revision so the continuity check accepts the hole (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_record_rejected.common_causes: A Runtime bug: a payload the ledger refuses to store.
ledger_record_rejected.handling: Report it as a Runtime bug with the event id; business continued.

ledger_schema_incomplete.description: The ledger reports ledger schema incomplete.

ledger_selection_query_unsupported.description: A query on a selected ledger read named no event type, an event type the read did not select, or a ledger view; the read refuses instead of returning an incomplete result.
ledger_selection_query_unsupported.common_causes: A caller bug: code that opened the ledger for some event types queries another type or a view. The check-config preview never does.
ledger_selection_query_unsupported.handling: Report it as a Runtime bug together with the command that produced it. The ledger itself is not damaged.

ledger_snapshot_boundary_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger snapshot boundary mismatch.

ledger_snapshot_overflow.description: The ledger reports ledger snapshot overflow.

ledger_source_incomplete.description: The ledger reports ledger source incomplete.

ledger_sql_selection_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger sql selection mismatch.

ledger_sqlite_failed.description: The ledger reports ledger sqlite failed.

ledger_statistics_identity_failed.description: The ledger reports ledger statistics identity failed.

ledger_statistics_poisoned.description: The ledger reports ledger statistics poisoned.

ledger_store_mismatch.description: A sampled key's current value in a memory store (actual) differs from the latest committed record of that key in the ledger index (expected), at a revision already committed; neither side is changed and each stretch is reported once (Workflow #383 AO-8).
ledger_store_mismatch.common_causes: A Runtime bug: a store change that was not captured, or a capture that does not match the change.
ledger_store_mismatch.handling: Report it as a Runtime bug with the key and both revisions.

ledger_store_revision_skipped.description: A revisioned source's records in the ledger jumped from expected_revision to source_revision without a gap record covering the hole: a business change reached the store without passing its gate (Workflow #383 AO-2, AO-8).
ledger_store_revision_skipped.common_causes: A Runtime bug: a write path that bypasses the capture interface.
ledger_store_revision_skipped.handling: Report it as a Runtime bug; the store and the ledger are left as they are.

ledger_tag_index_mismatch.description: An index row of the ledger points at a record whose key or value hash differs from the row; the persisted state breaks an invariant and the Runtime refuses to start (Workflow #383 AO-6).
ledger_tag_index_mismatch.common_causes: A damaged or edited state root, or a Runtime bug in index maintenance.
ledger_tag_index_mismatch.handling: Restore the state root from a backup or report it as a Runtime bug; do not edit the database by hand.

ledger_tag_key_unclassified.description: A workbench key matched neither ledger_observer.tag.workbench_patterns nor tag.reobserve_prefixes, so it is not tagged and will not survive a restart; reported once per prefix (Workflow #383 AO-5).
ledger_tag_key_unclassified.common_causes: A new workbench key was added without classifying it.
ledger_tag_key_unclassified.handling: Add the key to one of the two configuration lists.

ledger_tagged_entries_dropped.description: At start count tagged entries of instances that are no longer in the configuration were not loaded (Workflow #383 AO-6).
ledger_tagged_entries_dropped.common_causes: An instance was removed from the configuration.

ledger_tagged_state_loaded.description: At start the memory stores were loaded from the ledger index and the records it points to: count keys, event_count records read, per source in source_counts (Workflow #383 AO-6).

ledger_tagged_state_seeded.description: The first start of a build with tagged loading on a ledger with history replayed the history once and wrote count value records for the tagged keys (Workflow #383 AO-5).
ledger_tagged_state_seeded.common_causes: Upgrading to the build that brings tagged loading.

ledger_tail_unconfirmed.description: The previous run ended without a close record and without a complete dump: a gap record covers the time from its last committed record to this start; the number of lost records is unknown (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_tail_unconfirmed.common_causes: The process was killed, crashed or lost power.
ledger_tail_unconfirmed.handling: None for the ledger; effects done just before the end may have no record.

ledger_transaction_owner_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger transaction owner mismatch.

ledger_view_schema_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger view schema mismatch.

ledger_view_source_incomplete.description: actingledger reports ledger view source incomplete.

ledger_write_failed.description: Every configured attempt to write a batch failed, or one attempt stalled beyond flush_attempt_stall_ms (then timeout_ms is set). The ledger wrote every unflushed record to the dump file (path) and the Runtime stopped; the next start imports the dump (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_write_failed.common_causes: A full disk, a broken file system, a ledger file another program holds or a hung storage device.
ledger_write_failed.handling: Repair the disk or the ledger file, then start the Runtime again; it imports the dump before it opens for work. Do not delete the dump file.

ledger_write_retried.description: Writing a batch of captured records failed and was retried after reading the ledger back; the batch was committed in the end. Reported once per stretch of retries with the number of attempts (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_write_retried.common_causes: A short I/O error, a busy database or a slow disk.
ledger_write_retried.handling: No action while it stays rare; frequent reports point at the disk that holds the state root.

legacy_diagnostic_invalid.description: Ledger forensics reports legacy diagnostic invalid.

legacy_diagnostic_read_limit.description: Ledger forensics reports legacy diagnostic read limit.

lift_check_hash_unmeasured.description: A suspension lift check could not measure the content hash of a package the paused task's run went through (Workflow #336 PKG-S3, M-PKG D18): the package was removed, is being replaced or could not be read, or the task's procedure names no package location (path absent). The pause stays; the package is measured again at a later check. Linked as a note under the pause the check kept.
lift_check_hash_unmeasured.common_causes: The package was deleted or moved, or a replacement was in progress when the check read it.
lift_check_hash_unmeasured.handling: Put the package back at its configured path, or finish its replacement. The next check measures it again and lifts the pause when its content changed.

limit_exceeded.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): limit exceeded.

log_create_failed.description: The watchdog's start could not create the Runtime log.

loop_budget_missing.description: Catalog compile diagnostic: a task's loop budget or runtime bound is missing or zero.

maintenance_arguments_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports maintenance arguments invalid.

maintenance_artifact_material_unavailabl.description: ledger-maintenance refused a root whose artifact retention is not settled: on a formal root an eviction intent without its outcome (pending_evictions counts the artifacts), on a Segment root any recorded eviction.
maintenance_artifact_material_unavailabl.common_causes: A hard stop (power loss, forced reboot) between an eviction intent and its outcome; a Segment root that already records evictions.
maintenance_artifact_material_unavailabl.handling: Start actingd once on the root so that startup recovery finishes the pending eviction, then run the maintenance operation again.

maintenance_budget_exceeded.description: The runtime database reports maintenance budget exceeded.

maintenance_config_invalid.description: An offline actingd maintenance command (ledger-maintenance) refused its configuration: the schema version is not the one this build reads, the state root is empty, or secret_fingerprint_salt is outside 16 to 1024 bytes.
maintenance_config_invalid.common_causes: A configuration written for another Runtime release, or one edited by hand.
maintenance_config_invalid.handling: Use the configuration of the installed Runtime, or commit it again with acsetup --commit-config, then repeat the maintenance command.

maintenance_config_missing.description: actingd ledger-maintenance was given no --config. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_config_missing.common_causes: A caller that omits the configuration path.

maintenance_deadline_overflow.description: The runtime database reports maintenance deadline overflow.

maintenance_evidence_capacity_exceeded.description: The Runtime host reports maintenance evidence capacity exceeded.

maintenance_evidence_timestamp_missing.description: The Runtime host reports maintenance evidence timestamp missing.

maintenance_io_failed.description: The Runtime host reports maintenance io failed.

maintenance_ledger_position_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports maintenance ledger position invalid.

maintenance_ledger_position_query_failed.description: The Runtime host reports maintenance ledger position query failed.

maintenance_ledger_query_failed.description: The Runtime host reports maintenance ledger query failed.

maintenance_ledger_query_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports maintenance ledger query invalid.

maintenance_limits_invalid.description: The runtime database reports maintenance limits invalid.

maintenance_material_changed.description: The runtime database reports maintenance material changed.

maintenance_operation_invalid.description: actingd ledger-maintenance was given an operation other than dry-run, import, verify, backup or restore. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_operation_invalid.handling: Name one of the five operations.

maintenance_option_invalid.description: actingd ledger-maintenance was given an option other than --config, --backup, --target or --artifact-root, an option twice, an empty value, or a dangling argument. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_option_invalid.common_causes: A misspelt option or a missing value.
maintenance_option_invalid.handling: Correct the options of the maintenance command.

maintenance_path_invalid.description: The runtime database reports maintenance path invalid.

maintenance_path_missing.description: The Runtime host reports maintenance path missing.

maintenance_path_unsafe.description: The runtime database reports maintenance path unsafe.

maintenance_paths_overlap.description: The runtime database reports maintenance paths overlap.

maintenance_receipt_encode_failed.description: actingd ledger-maintenance could not encode its receipt as JSON; the report line then carries only this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_receipt_encode_failed.common_causes: A defect in the receipt's construction.
maintenance_receipt_encode_failed.handling: Report it with the build; run the maintenance again only after checking the ledger with verify.

maintenance_recheck_suggested.description: A predictive maintenance assessment of a task on an instance suggests a recheck: the outcome of a drift_predicted planning signal.

maintenance_size_overflow.description: The runtime database reports maintenance size overflow.

maintenance_target_invalid.description: The runtime database reports maintenance target invalid.

maintenance_trend_policy_invalid.description: A runtime client call failed: maintenance trend policy invalid.

maintenance_usage_invalid.description: actingd ledger-maintenance was given fewer or more arguments than an operation with its options allows. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_usage_invalid.common_causes: A caller that omits the operation or passes extra arguments.
maintenance_usage_invalid.handling: Run actingd ledger-maintenance <dry-run|import|verify|backup|restore> --config <path> with the operation's options.

malformed_owner_metadata.description: The ledger reports malformed owner metadata.

malformed_rows.description: The stored resource target rows of an instance are malformed, so its policy is unreadable.

matched_template_rect_unavailable.description: The page projection's reason for a blocked element or a missing target: matched template rect unavailable.

material_export_failed.description: The MCP server could not write an export file.

material_not_provided.description: Ledger forensics reports material not provided.

material_not_text.description: ac_material: the material is not text at this offset.

material_query_invalid.description: ac_material could not form its event query.

material_read_assembly_mismatch.description: A runtime client call failed: material read assembly mismatch.

material_read_budget_exceeded.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): material read budget exceeded.

material_read_cancelled.description: A runtime client call failed: material read cancelled.

material_read_chunk_invalid.description: A runtime client call failed: material read chunk invalid.

material_read_chunk_missing.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: material read chunk missing.

material_read_deadline_overflow.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): material read deadline overflow.

material_read_encode_failed.description: Ledger forensics reports material read encode failed.

material_read_failure_already_recorded.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: material read failure already recorded.

material_read_length_overflow.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): material read length overflow.

material_read_limit_mismatch.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: material read limit mismatch.

material_read_missing.description: A material read found no file for an artifact that has no eviction proof; the read result is missing and the Runtime records nothing.
material_read_missing.common_causes: A frame deleted by hand from the state root's artifacts folder.
material_read_missing.handling: Nothing to repair in the Runtime; the frame is gone. Read another frame, or restore the file from a copy if it is still needed.

material_read_output_failed.description: Ledger forensics reports material read output failed.

material_read_receipt_selection_mismatch.description: A runtime client call failed: material read receipt selection mismatch.

material_read_reference_changed.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): material read reference changed.

material_read_reply_limit.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): material read reply limit.

material_read_request_invalid.description: A runtime client call failed: material read request invalid.

material_read_request_mismatch.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: material read request mismatch.

material_read_result_missing.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: material read result missing.

material_read_retention_mismatch.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: material read retention mismatch.

material_read_source_changed.description: A runtime client call failed: material read source changed.

material_read_source_mismatch.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: material read source mismatch.

material_read_source_missing.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: material read source missing.

material_read_verification_mismatch.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): material read verification mismatch.

material_ref_invalid.description: ac_material: ref is not a materials[].ref of ac_events.

material_ref_unknown.description: ac_material: the ledger holds no such event and material at this sequence.

material_too_large.description: ac_material: the material is larger than an export may be.

material_unavailable.description: The Runtime answered a material read without the material: material_state is the read state and material_limit why it stopped short; the Runtime's typed failure code, when it gave one, is the caused_by link.

max_steps_reached.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2 train): a contained task's stability termination stopped because it reached its declared maximum number of steps.

mcp_batch_empty.description: JSON-RPC -32600: an MCP batch array was empty.

mcp_batch_unsupported.description: JSON-RPC -32600: a batch array arrived outside a session initialized with protocol 2025-03-26.

mcp_config_program_unresolved.description: actingctl mcp-config cannot name the program a client registers: the executable or the installation selection cannot be read, or a slot's fixed entry is missing.

mcp_config_program_unsupported.description: actingctl mcp-config cannot write the client configuration for this program path (not Unicode, or a double quote for claude).

mcp_file_too_large.description: mcp-serve, or actingctl overview reading the build manifest, read a file (a configuration, a manifest, an export) larger than its bound limit_bytes.

mcp_identity_card_refused.description: The Runtime refused mcp-serve's governance identity card (governance.allowed_clients); the write went ahead without it and the refusal is the caused_by link.

mcp_input_failed.description: mcp-serve could not read stdin and ended; the OS error is the caused_by link.

mcp_message_malformed.description: JSON-RPC -32700: an MCP message line is not JSON; the parser's error is the caused_by link.

mcp_message_too_large.description: JSON-RPC -32700: an MCP message line is longer than limit_bytes and was skipped.

mcp_method_unknown.description: JSON-RPC -32601: mcp-serve has no such method.

mcp_params_invalid.description: JSON-RPC -32602: a params or _meta member of an MCP request is missing, of the wrong type or not recognised (argument names it).

mcp_protocol_version_missing.description: JSON-RPC -32602: a request neither follows a legacy initialize nor carries the _meta protocol version and client capabilities.

mcp_protocol_version_unsupported.description: JSON-RPC -32022: a request's _meta names a protocol version mcp-serve does not take that way; data lists the supported versions.

mcp_request_id_in_use.description: JSON-RPC -32600: a tools/call request with this id is still in flight.

mcp_request_invalid.description: JSON-RPC -32600: an MCP message is not a JSON-RPC 2.0 request or notification.

mcp_server_start_failed.description: mcp-serve could not start one of its threads (thread); the OS error is the caused_by link.

mcp_tier_retired.description: mcp-serve was started with the retired --tier argument. MCP has no tiers from #389 U-3 on: the server starts as usual with every general tool and the tools of the installed Lab options, and reports this once on stderr and in the tools/list warnings.
mcp_tier_retired.common_causes: A harness configuration written before #389 U-3.
mcp_tier_retired.handling: Remove --tier from the harness configuration; actingctl mcp-config prints the current form.

mcp_tool_panicked.description: An MCP tool call panicked; the server goes on.

mcp_workers_unavailable.description: The MCP server has no worker thread for the call.

migration_backup_source_mismatch.description: The Runtime host reports migration backup source mismatch.

migration_binding_mismatch.description: The ledger reports migration binding mismatch.

migration_canonical_mismatch.description: The ledger reports migration canonical mismatch.

migration_completion_missing.description: The ledger reports migration completion missing.

migration_current_state_conflict.description: The Runtime host reports migration current state conflict.

migration_identity_invalid.description: The ledger reports migration identity invalid.

migration_identity_mismatch.description: The ledger reports migration identity mismatch.

migration_prefix_invalid.description: The ledger reports migration prefix invalid.

migration_prefix_mismatch.description: The ledger reports migration prefix mismatch.

migration_prefix_missing.description: The ledger reports migration prefix missing.

migration_projection_mismatch.description: The ledger reports migration projection mismatch.

migration_record_invalid.description: The ledger reports migration record invalid.

migration_requires_import_transaction.description: The ledger reports migration requires import transaction.

migration_source_changed.description: The ledger reports migration source changed.

migration_source_incomplete.description: The ledger reports migration source incomplete.

migration_source_invalid.description: The ledger reports migration source invalid.

missing_frame_context.description: The artifact store reports missing frame context.

missing_key.description: An environment detection result lacks a declared key.

missing_required_field.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): missing required field.

missing_resource_authoring_failure_code.description: Event or record sanitization refused a value: missing resource authoring failure code.

monitor_committed_state_missing.description: The Runtime host reports monitor committed state missing.

monitor_decision_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports monitor decision invalid.

monitor_due_query_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports monitor due query invalid.

monitor_file_open_failed.description: The Runtime host reports monitor file open failed.

monitor_file_read_failed.description: The Runtime host reports monitor file read failed.

monitor_frame_identity_missing.description: The Runtime host reports monitor frame identity missing.

monitor_import_conflict.description: The Runtime host reports monitor import conflict.

monitor_import_source_conflict.description: The Runtime host reports monitor import source conflict.

monitor_instance_unknown.description: The Runtime host reports monitor instance unknown.

monitor_journal_too_large.description: The Runtime host reports monitor journal too large.

monitor_ledger_failure.description: The Runtime host reports monitor ledger failure.

monitor_metadata_failed.description: The Runtime host reports monitor metadata failed.

monitor_observation_invalid.description: A provider's monitor observation is invalid or names another expected page.

monitor_observation_unavailable.description: The execution provider has no monitor observation surface.

monitor_policy_cleared.description: actingctl monitor-clear: the Runtime cleared the instance's monitor policy.

monitor_policy_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports monitor policy invalid.

monitor_policy_set.description: actingctl monitor-set: the Runtime took the instance's monitor policy.

monitor_probe_id_issue_failed.description: The Runtime host reports monitor probe id issue failed.

monitor_record_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports monitor record invalid.

monitor_recovery_fencing_state_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports monitor recovery fencing state invalid.

monitor_revision_overflow.description: The Runtime host reports monitor revision overflow.

monitor_source_changed.description: The Runtime host reports monitor source changed.

monitor_state_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports monitor state invalid.

monitor_status_reported.description: actingctl monitor-status: the Runtime reported its monitor registry.

monotonic_clock_overflow.description: The Runtime host reports monotonic clock overflow.

monotonic_clock_regressed.description: The Runtime host reports monotonic clock regressed.

mumu_manager_version_unsupported.description: The Runtime host reports mumu manager version unsupported.

mumu_root_invalid.description: actingd's configuration member mumu_root is empty or not an absolute path. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
mumu_root_invalid.common_causes: A relative path or an empty string written for the MuMu folder.
mumu_root_invalid.handling: Set mumu_root to the absolute path of the MuMu installation folder, or remove it to let the Runtime find MuMu. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

navigation_arrival_failed.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): navigation arrival failed.

navigation_destructive_overlap.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): navigation destructive overlap.

navigation_page_drift.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): navigation page drift.

navigation_target_not_visible.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): navigation target not visible.

nemu_app_index_invalid.description: A device instance that pairs Nemu touch with Nemu capture names a nemu_app_index outside the range the Nemu input accepts. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
nemu_app_index_invalid.common_causes: A negative index or one copied from another tool's numbering.
nemu_app_index_invalid.handling: Set nemu_app_index to a valid index. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

nemu_app_index_missing.description: The Runtime host reports nemu app index missing.

nemu_app_index_requires_paired_input.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): nemu app index requires paired input.

nemu_application_identity_invalid.description: The Runtime host reports nemu application identity invalid.

nemu_close_instance_missing.description: The Runtime host reports nemu close instance missing.

nemu_input_capability_unsupported.description: The Runtime host reports nemu input capability unsupported.

nemu_input_deadline_overflow.description: The Runtime host reports nemu input deadline overflow.

nemu_input_fencing_required.description: An input on a paired Nemu session lacks its fencing check.

nemu_input_frame_required.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): nemu input frame required.

nemu_input_frame_source_missing.description: A committed input frame of a paired Nemu session lacks its capture geometry source.

nemu_input_requires_paired_capture.description: The Runtime host reports nemu input requires paired capture.

nemu_input_task_deadline_missing.description: The Runtime host reports nemu input task deadline missing.

nemu_paired_input_configuration_missing.description: A device instance selects Nemu touch without Nemu capture or without nemu_app_index; Nemu touch works only paired with Nemu capture. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
nemu_paired_input_configuration_missing.common_causes: touch_backend switched to Nemu while capture_backend stayed another backend, or nemu_app_index left out.
nemu_paired_input_configuration_missing.handling: Use Nemu capture and set nemu_app_index together with Nemu touch, or choose another touch backend. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

nemu_session_close_failed.description: The paired Nemu session failed to close.

no_conditional_template_matched.description: Strategic planning-lane reason: no conditional template matched the assessment, so it needs planning.

nonfatal_error_marked_fatal.description: The Runtime host reports nonfatal error marked fatal.

not_implemented.description: A code several owners emit with one meaning (contract-owned, A2a D3): not implemented.

observation_containment_failed.description: A contained page observation package was not admitted.

observation_evidence_encode_failed.description: The Runtime host reports observation evidence encode failed.

observation_evidence_limit_exceeded.description: The Runtime host reports observation evidence limit exceeded.

observation_fact_encode_failed.description: Runtime contract validation refused a value: observation fact encode failed.

observation_fact_failed.description: A contained page observation fact could not be encoded within its budget.

observation_frame_context_missing.description: The Runtime host reports observation frame context missing.
